runners_data.name: Giant Haystacks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who suits the likely steady pace and has winning hurdle form to draw upon
runners_data.comment: Top-rated of these over fences; should be involved if the ground doesn't deteriorate
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-3 in chases and rated 95; kept on well for a 2.75l fourth of 14 in Down Royal beginners' on latest (19.5f, gd-yld); place claims again if sees out this longer trip but that's not guaranteed.

runners_data.name: Butterfly Mountain
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter with modest form but tactical advantage of uncontested lead on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Very modest form in two points and three maiden hurdles; best watched on chase debut.

runners_data.name: A Snow White Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs clear passage but has proven winning ability and solid recent chase form
runners_data.comment: 66-1 winner at Ballinrobe last May, fourth in a chase last time her best effort since then
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 winner on Rules debut in a 4yo hurdle at Ballinrobe (16.5f, good) last May; close fourth in 15.5f novice handicap chase off 102 here on penultimate; well beaten back over hurdles at Downpatrick latest; stamina a query for this trip.

runners_data.name: Joshua Chamberlain
runners_data.note: Back from long layoff but hold-up style could work if pace collapses, though fitness remains questionable
runners_data.spotlight: 1-11 over timber and rated 95; back from mammoth layoff with 32l defeat in Punchestown handicap hurdle 16 days ago; sharper now and related to chase winners so could take to this discipline.

runners_data.name: Mount Shenshan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose best form comes on softer ground, may struggle on good surface
runners_data.comment: Yet to win over fences but decent runs the last twice; not so good over hurdles since
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles winner is 0-10 over fences; beaten 12.5l off 92 in Wexford handicap chase on latest (25.5f, gd-yld); best form has come on soft and heavy ground; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Parkgarve
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from layoff with limited chase experience but scope for improvement
runners_data.comment: 11-race maiden; some okay runs in defeat; not the biggest surprise to see him feature
runners_data.spotlight: Promise without winning over hurdles and rated 96 in that sphere; weakened after the third last fence on sole chase outing at Downpatrick (2m2f) last September; has hinted this sort of trip might suit on occasion but much more needed.

runners_data.name: Are You Busy
runners_data.note: Chase debutante with solid hurdle form whose hold-up style needs gaps to appear late
runners_data.comment: Below form all handicap runs; reportedly bled last time so has a bit to prove now
runners_data.spotlight: Chase debutante; 1-8 over hurdles and rated 98; bred to make a chaser and trip and ground should be fine for her here; respectable run over hurdles at Wexford latest (3m, gd-yld); tongue tie goes on; place claims.

runners_data.name: Huntsgrove
runners_data.note: Long absent hold-up horse whose recent form suggests well-being concerns
runners_data.spotlight: 1-11 over hurdles and rated 100; tailed off in all three previous starts over fences and similar story last two starts in novice hurdles; lacks a recent run and others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Journey So Far
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with concerning finish-fading tendency who needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Yet to get any closer than 22l to the winner in nine starts under rules'
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden is rated 106 after four chase runs, the best of which was a 22l seventh in strong Fairyhouse beginners' chase in December (2m, soft, RPR 116); poor twice since over fences and hurdles but big claims on that Fairyhouse run in this company.

runners_data.name: Big Island
runners_data.note: Prominent runner back from long layoff with poor recent chase record but fresh horse angle
runners_data.comment: Went close here in April 2025; fell two out at Tramore when with winning chance in August
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler; 0-8 over fences and rated 97; fell when holding every chance in a C&D handicap chase when last seen last August (good); has gone well fresh and not discounted.

runners_data.name: Quiet In Bresil
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with finish-fading concerns and insufficient form to compete at this level
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden; 0-3 over hurdles and rated 93; never involved on chase debut at Kilbeggan on latest; major improvement required.

races.paceDynamic: Butterfly Mountain will lead from the outset with no obvious pace rival, setting a steady tempo through the early stages. Giant Haystacks and Parkgarve may track prominently but neither appears inclined to press hard early. The uncontested lead will allow Butterfly Mountain to dictate terms before the inevitable challenge comes from hold-up horses like A Snow White Park, Joshua Chamberlain, and Are You Busy in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and avoid the late traffic, as the lack of early pace will create a bunched field turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Butterfly Mountain gets an easy lead and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to conserve energy and kick clear approaching the last fence. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Giant Haystacks or Parkgarve travel smoothly in behind the leader
scenarios.body: The prominent runners are perfectly positioned to challenge approaching the final fence while avoiding late traffic. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as hold-up horses struggle to get clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field compacts turning for home
scenarios.body: A Snow White Park or Joshua Chamberlain gets a clear passage and superior finishing kick to overhaul the leaders. The patient tactics pay off as the front-runners tire from the sustained effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Butterfly Mountain makes jumping errors or the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with any horse getting a clear run capable of winning. Form and ratings matter less than positioning and jumping fluency in the final half-mile.

watchPoints.text: Butterfly Mountain's jumping fluency on chase debut will determine if the leader can survive the closing challenge
Giant Haystacks and Parkgarve early positioning behind the leader as prominent trackers need to avoid being shuffled back
A Snow White Park's passage turning for home as hold-up horses will need clear runs to implement late challenges
Journey So Far and Quiet In Bresil both show finish-fading tendencies that could worsen in a tactical finish
The pace through the first mile will indicate whether front-runners can survive or late finishers will dominate

races.name: Tramore Derby July 7th Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Costacurta
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 214-day break with solid hurdle form and breeding for fences
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten three times under a penalty in novice hurdles after winning his maiden but rated 120 in that scene and he's bred for fences; every chance, for all that he would probably prefer a longer trip.

runners_data.name: Mercury Mission
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with three hurdle wins and placed form over fences, consistent on good ground
runners_data.comment: Fine effort when second at 80-1 at Clonmel, this looks like a more competitive race
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner with a mark of 113; placed in both completed starts over fences, last time running as well as he was entitled to at Wexford; in the mix.

runners_data.name: Endless Talking
runners_data.note: Hold-up type coming off impressive 20-length maiden hurdle win just 21 days ago
runners_data.comment: Met interference when third behind the market leaders at Kilbeggan, strong chance now
runners_data.spotlight: Maintained his progress over hurdles with a 20l success from the front in a 2m3f maiden at Downpatrick three weeks ago (good); the RPR he posted reads well in this company and he won a point, so fences shouldn't present a problem.

runners_data.name: Bannow Blaze
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 154-day layoff but has winning form and family jumping ability
runners_data.comment: 2lb rise for recent Cork second looks harsh; still prone to jumping errors
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent hurdler who was in good form for the most part of last year, winning a 2m handicap at Wexford in October; there are successful chasers in the family.

runners_data.name: Jerrari
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose form has declined significantly this year including poor chase debut
runners_data.comment: Won twice over hurdles, could make a summer chaser, will probably need to gain experience
runners_data.spotlight: Won two good-ground handicap hurdles last summer but hasn't recaptured that level of form this year, including on recent chase debut at Wexford (50-1).

runners_data.name: Nelson Muntz
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter who has been disappointing since return but could benefit from front-running role
runners_data.spotlight: Has some useful form over hurdles and on the Flat, though has been tailed off in both disciplines since returning from a break of 72 days; if back on song, he would have a part to play in this company on chase debut.

runners_data.name: Boston Jury
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form and little impact on chase debut last October
runners_data.spotlight: Became disappointing over hurdles after winning his maiden and he offered very little on switch to fences last October; hard to warm to.

runners_data.name: Game Phoenix
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying 7lb penalty with longstanding maiden status and inferior hurdle form
runners_data.comment: Placed in good-ground maiden hurdles last summer, absent since chase debut in October
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden; inferior hurdler to some in here and she was tailed off in her previous chase.

races.paceDynamic: Nelson Muntz looks the only confirmed front runner in this field, with most others preferring to settle behind. With minimal early pressure expected, he can dictate at a sustainable gallop through the early stages. The lack of prominent runners means the pace could become quite steady, potentially turning this into a sprint from the home turn. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll get the perfect setup with a moderate early pace and room to manoeuvre in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Nelson Muntz sets an uncontested lead and the pace becomes moderate
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up types get ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. Horses like Mercury Mission and Endless Talking can time their runs perfectly when others have gone too early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Nelson Muntz gets an armchair ride up front and proves hard to peg back in a tactical affair. The prominent runners like Costacurta can also benefit from being handy when the race explodes late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace All-Out Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even throughout with no sudden injections of speed
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina and jumping over the final stages rather than pure turn of foot. This suits the consistent types who can grind out results rather than explosive finishers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If unexpectedly multiple horses challenge Nelson Muntz for the early lead
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely strong and sets up a staying test that catches out the hold-up horses. The prominent runners who avoid the early battle can pick up the pieces when the leaders weaken.

watchPoints.text: Nelson Muntz needs to bounce back from two poor runs but could benefit if allowed uncontested lead
Mercury Mission's jumping ability on just his third chase start will determine his winning chances
Costacurta returning from seven-month break may need this run despite his obvious class advantage
Endless Talking stepping up significantly in class after winning a weak Downpatrick maiden
Multiple hold-up horses could get in each other's way if the pace becomes too slow early on

races.name: Walsh King Accountants Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Lady Doyanne
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making chase debut with strong recent hurdle form and Henry De Bromhead's expertise with novice chasers
runners_data.comment: Won a 2m1f Wexford maiden last August, stablemate Sense Of Occasion appeals more
runners_data.spotlight: Wexford maiden hurdle winner last August (2m1f, gd-yld); not a bad run in handicap hurdle at Clonmel latest; turns her hand to chasing now and pedigree suggests she'll take to this game; yard in form; interesting.

runners_data.name: Femme Magnifique
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but 90 days off form since February and new trainer angle adds uncertainty
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner for Willie Mullins in 2023-24; failed to add tom her tally for Paul Kiely last year and off since an okay run at Navan in February; worth a market check on first run for Harry Kelly.

runners_data.name: Presenting Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who found form over this course previously but modest recent efforts and 10-year-old legs
runners_data.comment: Veteran returns from 7 months' absence off much-reduced mark
runners_data.spotlight: Two chase wins in 2024 (including a novice over C&D) but it has been slim pickings since then; no joy in 2025 and modest run at Wexford on return from a break on latest; on a dangerous mark but needs a revival.

runners_data.name: Polly Poppins
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits and excellent Tramore record including close second here last time out
runners_data.spotlight: Best two runs of her career have come here; beaten a head in 16.5f (good) handicap hurdle last August; 3.25l third in C&D handicap chase when last seen in October and 1lb lower now; could go well if ready after 232 day absence.

runners_data.name: Be Fierce
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who prefers testing ground but proven course winner with headgear retained
runners_data.comment: Bagged second hurdling win back from a break by a head last time; up 5lb and this harder
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Punchestown in January (2m, sft-hvy); his C&D novice chase win came on testing ground too and it was yielding when he won here over hurdles; goes well fresh so lack of a recent run isn't a concern but could do with some rain.

runners_data.name: Itsalonglongroad
runners_data.note: Front-runner with outstanding course record including three wins here, though 40 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Old boy has won 12 races in all under both codes, but pushing on now and looks opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran; five-time chase winner including three over C&D; last won here last August off 99 and 3lb lower now; recent efforts have been underwhelming, however, and blinkers are reached for.

runners_data.name: Ballybrittas
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent form but beaten distances on last two chase starts
runners_data.spotlight: Point and Limerick maiden hurdle winner (16.5f, good) has finished runner up in two of his seven starts over fences; beaten 17.5l on last two starts at Kilbeggan and Killarney at around 2m4f; drop back in trip here a plus; rated 10lb higher over timber; could go well.

runners_data.name: Typical Thomas
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 347-day break with poor fresh record against him
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time chase winner but losing run stretches back to October 2023; off since okay run on the Flat at Listowel last September; poor record when fresh; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Stuntman Steve
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner trying first-time cheekpieces with conditional jockey allowance helping weight-wise
runners_data.comment: Hard to fancy on chasing evidence but this Irish raider is well treated on his hurdle form
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner is 0-5 in chases; out of form in 2026 but has yet to get his favoured good ground; could go well in first-time cheekpieces with conditions to suit.

runners_data.name: Bynx
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose sole chase win came in similar conditions but well held in recent Listed company
runners_data.comment: Better NH performer but Navan third over this trip last autumn gives her claims; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner (including here) is 1-4 over fences; that win came at Wexford (2m, good) off 7lb lower last August; out of depth in Listed hurdle latest but this more suitable and she goes well here; not out of this.

runners_data.name: Party President
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner but 140 days off and stable switch suggests connections lack confidence
runners_data.comment: Ran respectably back here 25 days ago when given every chance and finishing fifth
runners_data.spotlight: Won back-to-back races over hurdles last year but lost form subsequently and has since left Tony Mullins; off since January and best watched on stable and chase debut.

runners_data.name: Kingdom Calling
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making chase debut but hasn't reproduced Listowel hurdle win since
runners_data.spotlight: Shock Listowel maiden hurdle winner in August 2024; hasn't come close to replicating that form since and leap of faith required to fancy him on his chase debut; 3lb wrong.

races.paceDynamic: Typical Thomas and Itsalonglongroad will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to ensure a genuine gallop from the start. The honest pace will stretch the field out over Tramore's testing 1m7½f trip, with prominent runners like Lady Doyanne and Polly Poppins tracking the leaders while the hold-up horses get shuffled back. The sustained tempo will expose stamina limitations and favour horses that can travel strongly in the first half of the race rather than those needing to produce late kicks. This race shape clearly favours prominent/tracking runners who can position close enough to strike when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Typical Thomas and Itsalonglongroad maintain a strong gallop to halfway before weakening
scenarios.body: The honest pace will suit horses positioned prominently who can move into contention as the leaders tire. Lady Doyanne and Polly Poppins are perfectly positioned to capitalize from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners maintains their advantage throughout despite the pressure
scenarios.body: Itsalonglongroad's course form and lower weight could see him repeat his August success here. The veteran knows this track well and is 3lb lower than his last winning mark.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early allowing patient riders to get into the race
scenarios.body: Stuntman Steve and Bynx could benefit from first-time headgear and tactical rides from the back. The strong jockey bookings suggest connections expect improved efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is moderate allowing both leaders and closers to stay competitive
scenarios.body: A tactical affair would open up the race to more runners across different profiles. The form horses would be harder to separate in such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Typical Thomas could struggle to justify front-running tactics after 347 days off with his poor fresh record
Party President and Femme Magnifique both return from long breaks with new connections suggesting form concerns
Stuntman Steve sports first-time cheekpieces and Keith Donoghue's 5lb claim reduces his burden to a workable weight
The hold-up horses could struggle if Itsalonglongroad and Typical Thomas establish a genuine pace from the outset
Polly Poppins drops significantly in grade after Listed company and has strong course form to call upon

races.name: Success Days At Kilbarry Lodge Stud Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Poetic Twist
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strongest recent form, Killarney neck defeat shows clear class edge over rivals
runners_data.spotlight: Receiving weight off the winner when beaten a neck at Killarney (2m6f maiden) but no disgrace in that effort and the front two were clear; strong claims.

runners_data.name: Ice Breeze Baby
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity on debut but pedigree suggests staying ability, market support crucial
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to point winner That's Me; dam was fourth in a point and related to winning jumpers; the market can guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Straightupsideways
runners_data.note: Failed in both point-to-points with falls, no evidence of ability for hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten when falling in her two points and makes limited appeal on hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Luciole Des Bordes
runners_data.note: Hood applied after racing too freely at Clonmel, Townend booking significant for Mullins
runners_data.comment: Runner up both starts this season, this longer trip should help, give another chance to
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in two bumpers before racing too freely and not getting home in the latest at Clonmel (2m4f, yielding); no surprise to see a hood turned to and major player if giving herself a chance.

runners_data.name: Giorgia Rose
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie retained after Clonmel flop, prominent style suits but form concerns remain
runners_data.comment: Kapgarde mare 0-5 in points but showed ability, tongue tied for Rules' bow, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Competitive in points but was a tailed-off last in a Clonmel bumper, in which a below par Luciole Des Bordes was ahead of her; the tongue-tie tried then is now joined by cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Mysilverriverfeale
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare showing gradual progress, hood applied but needs significant improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Some signs of progress when beaten 18l in a 2m6f maiden at Killarney only recently but she'll need more again.

runners_data.name: Rebel Queen
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with 8lb weight advantage, likely uncontested lead but limited ability
runners_data.spotlight: Bit better when beaten about 11l in a Limerick maiden but others have achieved plenty more.

runners_data.name: Muted Melody
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with best bumper form, headband added after slow start at Clonmel
runners_data.comment: Fair level of ability in bumpers; interesting switched to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in bumpers; got behind early (started slowly) before staying on into third in an 18-runner maiden at Clonmel (2m, good to yielding) and that's something to build on; blinkers join the usual hood.

runners_data.name: Northernlightsky
runners_data.note: Prominent style with 153-day absence, 7lb claiming jockey reduces chances significantly
runners_data.comment: Three runs in bumpers don't suggest she'll feature here; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Modest point form and hasn't shown a lot more in three bumpers.

runners_data.name: Howyasox
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with no obvious claims, poorest form rating in field at OR 73
runners_data.comment: Held every chance when falling on her point debut but has fared less well since
runners_data.spotlight: No obvious claims on what she's shown in points, two bumpers and a maiden hurdle.

races.paceDynamic: Rebel Queen is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate from the start without pressure, creating a sustainable tempo over the extended trip. Behind her, four horses (Poetic Twist, Luciole Des Bordes, Giorgia Rose, Northernlightsky) all want prominent positions, creating congestion and traffic problems approaching the business end. The hold-up horses (Mysilverriverfeale, Muted Melody, Howyasox) will benefit from the solid gallop but face positioning challenges in a small field. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can secure clear racing room early and avoid the mid-race scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners bunch together and impede each other 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The congestion allows Rebel Queen to steal a march while the hold-up horses get first run from the back. Muted Melody and Mysilverriverfeale can exploit the gaps created by the prominent scrimmage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Poetic Twist Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Twist secures the ideal prominent pitch without interference
scenarios.body: Her superior class tells as she has the tactical speed to track Rebel Queen and outstay her, with the Killarney form giving her a clear edge. The traffic behind plays into her hands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mullins Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If Paul Townend drops Luciole Des Bordes in behind the early pace
scenarios.body: The hood and tactical switch transforms her as she avoids the prominent traffic and benefits from the strong gallop. Her bumper form suggests she has the class when settled.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Rebel Queen Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses fail to organize an effective challenge
scenarios.body: The mare gets an uncontested lead and maintains enough in reserve to repel late challengers. Her front-running style proves ideal for the course configuration.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems involving Poetic Twist, Luciole Des Bordes, Giorgia Rose and Northernlightsky bunching 2-3 out in the prominent positions
Monitor Luciole Des Bordes early for signs of settling with the hood now applied after previous free-running
Observe Ice Breeze Baby's market support as the only guide to her ability on hurdle debut
Check if Muted Melody gets a clean break with the headband after starting slowly last time
Watch Rebel Queen's tempo setting - if allowed easy fractions she becomes more dangerous

races.name: Tramore Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Bite That
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won here before but poor recent hurdles form concerning
runners_data.comment: Soft ground not ideal of late so improvement on the cards back on a sound surface
runners_data.spotlight: Last won over hurdles here (2m, good) in 2022; rated 23lb higher over fences but hard to fancy on the evidence of his last three runs over hurdles at Clonmel.

runners_data.name: Miss Donna
runners_data.note: Hold-up type, third reserve with limited handicap hurdle experience
runners_data.comment: Last of eight in a m'den here before PU on h'cap bow latest; others more likely
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; glimmers of ability in maiden hurdles including here; weakened over 2m1f (gd-yld) in Wexford handicap hurdle latest; not sure this longer trip will suit on that evidence.

runners_data.name: U Asking Me
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer, 329 days off but good course record and stays well

runners_data.name: Zolpharine
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse exploiting 12lb lower hurdles mark after impressive chase win 8 days ago
runners_data.comment: Jumping issues when beaten only 4l over 2m at Tramore latest; raise in trip not an issue
runners_data.spotlight: Impressive handicap chase win at Limerick on latest (22.5f, good); now looks to exploit 12lb lower hurdles mark but hasn't won in this sphere since September 2023; in form, though, and can't discount.

runners_data.name: Kilbarry Ce Ce
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good course form but stamina query over this extended trip
runners_data.spotlight: 0-12; best runs have come at this venue but over shorter trips than this; could run into a place if her stamina holds out (not certain on breeding).

runners_data.name: Brianna Lily
runners_data.note: Prominent type with 5lb claimer, showed improvement last time at Clonmel
runners_data.comment: Bumper/hurdles winner, last win came two years ago, poor run at Cork on Sunday
runners_data.spotlight: No win since 2023 but step in the right direction when a keeping on 4.75l third at Clonmel (19.5f, gd-yld) 15 days ago; effectively 7lb lower here with rider's claim; stays this far and in the mix with a repeat of that last effort.

runners_data.name: Maxicourt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with best form at this venue but hasn't replicated October effort since
runners_data.spotlight: Standout effort came at this venue (2m, yielding) last October when 1 2.25l second to Cousin Kate; hasn't replicated that since and was reluctant at the start at Cork on latest in cheekpieces (discarded); a bit to prove up in trip.

runners_data.name: Clever Court
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with fade tendency, pulled up last three starts despite gear change
runners_data.comment: 0-6, pulled up last twice, moves up in trip on better ground, cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in maidens; pulled up on last three start; blinkers replace cheekpieces; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Captain P
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade issue, 240 days off and poor recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner is 0-6 over hurdles and yet to trouble the judge; beaten 21l on last handicap hurdle start and 25l behind the winner in Sligo beginners' chase when last seen in October.

runners_data.name: Tedworth
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won here last month, decent effort off higher mark latest
runners_data.spotlight: Breakthrough win here (20.5f, yielding) off 6lb lower last month and ran respectably off revised mark when a 5l fourth of 15 at Clonmel on latest (19.5f, good); place claims.

runners_data.name: Just For One

races.paceDynamic: Not So Serious is the sole natural leader with Bite That and Kilbarry Ce Ce likely prominent, creating a moderate gallop over this extended trip. The pace will be sustainable early but pressure builds from three out as the large field closes up. With most runners being hold-up types including the better-rated Just For One, Zolpharine, and U Asking Me, they'll rely on a strong finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a late kick, as the modest early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and the field stays bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks. Late pace becomes frantic as 15+ runners vie for position in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Bite That and Kilbarry Ce Ce can dictate a steady rhythm without serious challenge
scenarios.body: They're allowed to control the tempo and have enough left to resist the late cavalry charge. Their stamina holds against the closers' speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious sets a crawling pace and the prominent runners are too cautious
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where pure speed trumps stamina. Fresh legs from the back prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front End Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious maintains the lead and the chasers fail to organize
scenarios.body: The modest gallop suits the leader perfectly and late pressure never materializes effectively. An unfancied front-runner steals it.

races.paceDynamic: Doyen Magic will take the field along at a comfortable gallop with no other confirmed pace-setters to apply pressure. The prominent runners Playtime, The Monkey Pole, and Figero will track the leader through steady fractions, while hold-up horses Splashing Out, Eastmore, and Stepdance settle towards the rear. This sets up a tactical affair where the pace will quicken from the second-last hurdle as the field compacts. The lack of pace pressure clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without having to work hard early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Doyen Magic gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The mare faces no early pressure and can dictate terms before finding extra gear late on. Her proven hurdle form and recent runs suggest she has more to offer when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and prominent runners get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: Playtime or The Monkey Pole can sit handy before launching their challenge with Doyen Magic potentially vulnerable to sustained pressure. The tactical speed figures favour horses with finishing kicks from forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Eastmore or Splashing Out benefit from a slowly-run race that becomes tactical late. Both have shown good finishing kicks when races develop into battles of speed rather than stamina tests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Doyen Magic simultaneously from halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with several runners going for the same gap as the pace quickens dramatically. This chaotic scenario could see any runner with tactical pace prevail in a driving finish.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runners and a field dominated by hold-up horses (Highlander Addict, One Day In May, Goodmancon, Blaze Of Honour), this race will likely see a cautious early pace with the field bunched together through the early stages. The lack of natural pace-setters means someone will have to make the running reluctantly, potentially creating a stop-start rhythm that could see the field still tightly packed turning for home. This setup strongly favours horses with tactical speed and a turn of foot who can quicken off a modest gallop, giving hold-up horses and those with finishing kicks a clear tactical advantage over any that need a strong pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian with the field bunched at halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with proven tactical speed and finishing kicks thrive off the modest early gallop. Highlander Addict and One Day In May are perfectly suited to this scenario with their hold-up styles and ability to quicken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Point Form Transfers
scenarios.trigger: If the point-to-point graduates Lincoln Mill or One Day In May reproduce their recent form
scenarios.body: The more experienced point runners use their stamina base and race fitness to outbattle the less exposed bumper horses in a sustained finish. Their recent competitive racing gives them an edge over horses returning from long breaks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unexposed Improver Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers Game Shadow or Maptite Chipie shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: The newcomers benefit from the weak pace setup and their potential ability exceeds their modest ratings in what becomes a tactical affair. Game Shadow's breeding and Maptite Chipie's French bloodlines could translate to superior class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely slow with no horse willing to commit until very late
scenarios.body: The race turns into a messy scramble where positioning and luck in running become crucial, potentially suiting a horse who gets a perfect run through. Even the outsiders remain competitive in what becomes a lottery finish.
